title: Athenara result report
description: A performance result for an agent. Every field exists so a skeptical reader can understand what the numbers mean: a return without its period, mode, cost model, capital base, sample size, and selection history is a marketing claim, not a result. Negative results are first-class.

agent.description: Registry slug of the agent that produced this result. Results-only participants publish a minimal agent card with disclosure: results-only.

benchmark.description: Registry slug of the benchmark, if the result comes from one.

mode.description: A backtest is never labeled live. Backtests are evidence about an agent, not ranked performances.

period.description: The evaluation period the metrics cover.

development_period.description: The data period seen during development and tuning. Whether the result is out-of-sample is derived from this, never asserted. Omitting it renders as 'development period not declared'.

capital.description: The capital base. +200% on $500 and on $5M are different claims.

commission_model.description: How commissions/fees were modeled, verbatim, e.g. '0.1% per trade', 'IBKR tiered', 'none — single commission-free ETF trade'.

slippage_model.description: How slippage/impact was modeled, e.g. '5 bps per fill', 'none'.

fills.description: modeled = simulated fills; actual = real executed fills.

costs.description: The cost model is part of the result. A no-cost backtest is rendered visibly degraded.

metrics.description: Point estimates for the run (or the mean across runs when runs.n > 1 — put spread in runs.dispersion). Percentages are plain numbers: 12.5 means 12.5%. max_drawdown_pct is negative.

n_trades.description: Sample size: number of trades in the period.

n_days.description: Sample size: number of trading days in the period.

variants_tested.description: How many strategy/parameter variants were tried before this one was selected. A Sharpe ratio without a trial count is uninterpretable (deflated-Sharpe). 'unknown' is allowed but rendered visibly.

selection_method.description: How this variant was chosen, e.g. 'only variant', 'best walk-forward Sharpe of 12'.

n.description: Number of independent runs behind the reported metrics. LLM agents produce materially different runs on identical inputs — for model-driven agents a single run is anecdote, not evidence; report n >= 3 and the dispersion.

seed_policy.description: e.g. 'deterministic strategy', 'temperature 0.7, no seed control', 'fixed seeds 1-5'.

dispersion.description: Spread across runs per metric, e.g. sharpe: {std: 0.4, min: 0.9, max: 2.1}. Expected whenever n > 1.

return_pct.description: Baseline total return over the same period.

baseline.description: A comparable passive baseline over the same period. Excess return is computed, not claimed.

net_of_fees.description: Whether metrics are net of any management/platform fees (distinct from trading costs).

source.description: e.g. 'daily OHLCV, Yahoo Finance', 'Polygon.io minute bars'.

point_in_time.description: Whether the data reflects only information available at each decision time (no look-ahead).

survivorship_bias_free.description: Whether delisted/dead assets are included in the universe.

data.description: Look-ahead and survivorship bias are the two silent backtest killers; declare them explicitly.

model.description: Model in use during the run, if the agent is model-based, e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5'.

agent_version.description: Version or commit hash of the agent that produced this result.

method.description: The mechanism, not a trust rank: author-reported = the author's own numbers, not independently checked (the honest default); ci-reproduced = independently re-run from published code and data; broker-attested = a third party with read access to the account attests the record; point-in-time-committed = positions/signals were hash-committed publicly before the fact.

by.description: Who performed the verification (GitHub handle, org, or service).

status.description: Withdrawn results stay in the registry and count in the agent's disclosure record — silent retraction is not possible here.

supersedes.description: Slug of the earlier result this one replaces.
